transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m just… really tired all the time. Even when I’ve been in bed all night, I wake up feeling heavy, like my body’s full of sand. Getting through work or even doing laundry feels like it takes everything I have.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or have lost interest in activities you normally care about?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to make time for hiking, yoga, working in my garden… taking bird photos, that kind of thing. Lately I just keep canceling, or my camera stays in the closet. It all feels like too much effort, I guess.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you’re not good enough?

Yeah… I do. I keep going over this mortgage decision we made, and I tell myself I was selfish or reckless. Like I put our whole household at risk. My husband says we decided together, but… it doesn’t really stop me from blaming myself.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or felt unusually fatigued, even when you haven’t done much physically?

Yeah. That’s kind of the main thing. I feel worn out almost all the time… even if I’ve been in bed all night. My body just feels heavy, like sandbags, and getting through work or even folding laundry can feel like it takes everything.
Have you noticed any trouble focusing, making decisions, or remembering things lately?

Yeah… especially at work. I’ll read the same survey results or a client email a few times and still feel like I’m not taking it in. Even picking which spreadsheet to start with can feel… weirdly hard.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt this consistently low and fatigued, or this is the first time?
I’m… not really sure. I’ve had rough patches before, I guess, but I don’t know if they were like this. It’s hard to compare.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt this low, tired, or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
Yeah… this time it’s been more than two weeks. I’d say the low, exhausted, slowed-down feeling has been there most days for maybe… around two months now.
Have you had multiple times in the past when you felt this low, lost interest in things, or had trouble with energy, or has this only happened once before?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’ve had times where I wasn’t doing great, but whether it was… the same kind of low, or more than once like this, I’m not sure.
Have you had more than one separate period in your life when you felt this low, lost interest in things, or had trouble with your energy—where each period lasted for several weeks or more?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t really keep track of it like that. There have been bad stretches, but I don’t know if they were separate periods lasting several weeks or… just life being hard.
Have you had more than one separate time in your life when you felt this low, lost interest in things, or had trouble with your energy—where each time lasted for several weeks or more?
I honestly don’t know. I know there’ve been rough patches, but I can’t really say if they were separate times lasting weeks like that.

Have you had more than one separate time in your life when you felt this low, lost interest in things, or had trouble with your energy—where each time lasted for several weeks or more, and you had a clear period of improvement in between?

I don’t really know. I mean… I can think of times I felt better after bad stretches, but I can’t say clearly whether there were multiple separate periods like that, with a definite improvement in between.

Have you had more than one separate time in your life when you felt this low, lost interest in things, or had trouble with your energy—where each time lasted for several weeks or more, and you had a clear period of improvement in between?

I’m sorry, I just… I don’t have a clear answer. I can’t really separate it out that neatly in my head. There were times I felt worse and times I felt more okay, but I don’t know if they count as separate stretches like you mean.
Can you think of a time when you felt clearly better for at least a few weeks—like back to your usual self—before this most recent period started?
I’m not really sure. I think there were times I was doing better, but whether it was a few weeks and fully back to normal… I can’t say for sure.
Can you think of a time when you felt completely back to your usual self—like really clear and functioning normally—for at least a couple of months before this most recent period started?
I don’t know… completely back to myself for a couple months feels hard to say. I might have had better stretches, but I’m not sure I’d call them fully normal.
Can you think of any time in your life before this current period when you had a clear stretch of feeling back to normal—like your usual self—for at least a couple of months?
I honestly can’t think of one clearly. Maybe there were times I was doing okay, but a couple months where I felt really like myself… I don’t know. I wouldn’t want to say yes if I’m not sure.

Looking back over the past few years, can you think of any time when you felt completely back to your usual self—like really clear, functioning normally, and free of these symptoms—for at least a couple of months?
I don’t think I can say that for sure. There may have been stretches where things were a little better, but completely back to normal for a couple months… I can’t really point to that.

Looking back, can you say for certain that you've had at least two separate times in your life when you felt this low and lost interest in things, each lasting several weeks or more, with a clear period of feeling back to normal in between those times?
No… I don’t think I can say that for certain. I know I’ve had low times, but the “two separate times” with a clear normal stretch in between… I’m not sure.

Can you say for sure that you’ve had at least two separate times in your life when you felt this low and lost interest in things, each lasting several weeks or more, and with a clear period of feeling back to normal in between those times?
I… no, I can’t say that for sure. It’s kind of blurry when I try to separate it out like that.

Looking back over your life, have you ever had two or more separate periods where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had low energy, each lasting several weeks or more, with clear periods of feeling back to normal in between?
I’m not really sure. I can remember feeling low at different points, but whether they were clearly separate like that, with me fully back to normal in between… I can’t say.
